info.title: validonce - lint regular expressions for portability across regex engines
info.description: Lint regular expressions in OpenAPI and JSON Schema documents for behavior that differs between JavaScript, Python, Rust and .NET regex engines.

options.name: --engines
options.description: comma-separated: js, js-u, python-re, rust-regex, dotnet (default: all)

options.name: --ignore
options.description: comma-separated finding ids to drop, e.g. VR005,VR014
